title: The Sunday Read: ‘How Do You Make a Weed Empire? Sell It Like Streetwear.’

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想当年在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个充满活力的、像快闪博物馆一样的美丽50年老物件展台。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自奥彼（Audemars Piguet）的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Ezra Marcus.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是埃兹拉·马库斯。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer to The New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: This week's Sunday Read is my profile of a Bay Area rapper who goes by the name of Burner.
sentences.zh: 本周的“周日阅读”是我为湾区一位名叫伯纳的饶舌歌手写的个人特写。

sentences.en: He's a guy you've probably never heard of who, in all fairness, is not the most accomplished rapper.
sentences.zh: 他是一个你可能从未听说过的人，平心而论，他也并非成就最高说唱歌手。

sentences.en: But he somehow always ends up alongside Jay-Z and Kanye on these lists of the five richest rappers in the world.
sentences.zh: 但不知为何，在这些全球五大最富有说唱歌手的榜单上，他总是能和Jay-Z以及坎耶并列。

sentences.en: That's because Burner is the CEO of Cookies, one of the largest, most well-known legal cannabis brands in the United States.
sentences.zh: 那是因为伯纳是Cookies的首席执行官，Cookies是美国最大、最知名的合法大麻品牌之一。

sentences.en: Maybe the best known.
sentences.zh: 也许是最知名的一个。

sentences.en: And what makes Burner fascinating is that, in a way, he embodies the current state of the cannabis industry as a whole.
sentences.zh: 而伯纳令人着迷的地方在于，在某种程度上，他正是整个大麻产业现状的缩影。

sentences.en: On the one side, a weed industry that's legal and yet completely hamstrung by regulation.
sentences.zh: 一方面是一个合法却又被监管彻底束缚的大麻产业。

sentences.en: And on the other, a black market that's still thriving and even facilitated by the supply from the legal side.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，是一个依然蓬勃发展、甚至由合法渠道的供应提供便利的地下黑市。

sentences.en: A couple decades ago,
sentences.zh: 几十年前，

sentences.en: Burner was working at a medical marijuana dispensary while also dealing weed on the street.
sentences.zh: 伯纳曾在医用大麻药房工作，同时也在街头贩卖大麻。

sentences.en: Weed was on the cusp of becoming recreationally legal in California, and Burner saw an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 当时大麻在加州正处于娱乐性合法化的边缘，伯纳敏锐地看到了商机。

sentences.en: He noticed that when he'd draw colorful labels for weed strains, they'd sell better.
sentences.zh: 他注意到，当他为不同品种的大麻绘制色彩斑斓的标签时，它们就卖得更好。

sentences.en: Branding is really important, he figured.
sentences.zh: 他心想，品牌塑造真的很重要。

sentences.en: And so he started using rap music as a marketing tool.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始将说唱音乐作为营销工具。

sentences.en: He made songs with famous rappers like Wiz Khalifa, who embody cannabis as a lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 他与维兹·卡利法等将大麻视为生活方式的知名说唱歌手合作创作歌曲。

sentences.en: And he built his brand around a novel strain of weed called Girl Scout Cookies.
sentences.zh: 并围绕一种名为“女童子军”的新颖大麻品种打造了自己的品牌。

sentences.en: He would give out three quarter pounds of it to dealers to spread awareness.
sentences.zh: 他会把四分之三磅的大麻分发给毒贩以扩大知名度。

sentences.en: It turned Burner into an iconic figure.
sentences.zh: 这让伯纳成为了一位标志性人物。

sentences.en: By the 2010s,
sentences.zh: 到了2010年代，

sentences.en: Burner was selling t-shirts and hoodies with a Cookies logo on them.
sentences.zh: 伯纳开始销售印有Cookies标志的T恤和连帽衫。

sentences.en: Then, after cannabis was legalized, he partnered with investors who transformed Cookies into a real company.
sentences.zh: 随后，在大麻合法化之后，他与投资者合作，将Cookies打造成了一家真正的公司。

sentences.en: But Cookies is different from these other large corporate cannabis companies which give off a kind of safe, almost medical consumer product kind of vibe.
sentences.zh: 但Cookies与其他那些散发着安全、几乎像医疗消费品氛围的大型企业化大麻公司有所不同。

sentences.en: Cookies trades on the romance of the black market and the subcultural cachet of illegal weed.
sentences.zh: Cookies贩卖的是黑市的浪漫色彩和非法大麻的亚文化声望。

sentences.en: It resonates with heavy cannabis consumers like nothing else.
sentences.zh: 它与重度大麻消费者的共鸣是其他任何东西都无法比拟的。

sentences.en: There are Cookies stores all over the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地到处都有Cookies的门店。

sentences.en: Anytime a new store opens, it's like this subcultural event akin to juggalos or deadheads.
sentences.zh: 每当新店开业，就像是一场类似小丑回魂狂热粉或感恩至死乐队粉丝的亚文化盛事。

sentences.en: Cookies obsessives will travel and line up around the block to meet Burner and buy Cookies merch.
sentences.zh: Cookies的狂热粉丝会不远万里赶来，在街区周围排起长队，只为了见伯纳一面并购买Cookies的周边商品。

sentences.en: None of that would be possible without Burner's brilliant marketing.
sentences.zh: 如果没有伯纳出色的营销，这一切都是不可能实现的。

sentences.en: I went to visit Burner at his compound in Marin County, California.
sentences.zh: 我前往加州马林县拜访了位于伯纳大本营的复合园区。

sentences.en: It's this giant, nondescript warehouse on the outside.
sentences.zh: 从外表看，这是一个巨大且毫无特色的仓库。

sentences.en: But inside, it's like an upscale WeWork office.
sentences.zh: 但走进内部，它看起来就像是一个高档的WeWork办公室。

sentences.en: But with all these stoner touches, there's trippy Hunter S.
sentences.zh: 不过处处都带有嬉皮士的风格，到处都是迷幻的亨特·S·

sentences.en: Thompson art and hallucinogenic scenes everywhere and tons of rooms displaying different projects.
sentences.zh: 汤普森的艺术作品和迷幻场景，还有大量展示不同项目的房间。

sentences.en: And then there's a bunch of guys sort of hanging out there.
sentences.zh: 接着有一群人在那里闲晃。

sentences.en: They're smoking,
sentences.zh: 他们在抽烟，

sentences.en: Burner's rolling joints.
sentences.zh: 伯纳在卷烟。

sentences.en: He's showing me big bags of weed strains he's developing.
sentences.zh: 他向我展示了他正在研发的大麻品种的大袋样品。

sentences.en: It's not your classic business school background.
sentences.zh: 这可不是你所熟悉的传统商学院背景。

sentences.en: It's almost the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 几乎可以说是完全相反。

sentences.en: And so, even though he is, in many ways, the archetypal stoner,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管他在许多方面都是典型的嬉皮士，

sentences.en: Burner clearly has a sophisticated, keen business mind.
sentences.zh: 但伯纳显然有着敏锐而复杂的商业头脑。

sentences.en: So, here's my article.
sentences.zh: 那么，这就是我的文章。

sentences.en: How do you make a weed empire?
sentences.zh: 如何打造一个大麻帝国？

sentences.en: Sell it like streetwear.
sentences.zh: 像卖潮牌一样去卖它。

sentences.en: Read by James Patrick Cronin.
sentences.zh: 由詹姆斯·帕特里克·克罗宁为您朗读。
zh_words: 詹姆斯·帕特里克·克罗宁

sentences.en: Our audio producer today is Jack DeSidoro.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的音频制作人是杰克·德西多罗。

sentences.en: And the music that you'll hear was written and performed by Aaron Esposito.
sentences.zh: 你所听到的音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托创作并演奏。

sentences.en: The closest thing to a bat signal for stoners is the blue lettering of the cookies logo.
sentences.zh: 大麻爱好者心目中最接近蝙蝠信号灯的东西，就是Cookies标志性的蓝色字体。

sentences.en: When a new storefront comes to a strip mall or a downtown shopping district, fans flock to grand opening parties drawn by a love of the brand.
sentences.zh: 当新店进驻商业街或市中心购物区时，狂热的粉丝们就会因对品牌的喜爱而蜂拥至盛大的开业派对。

sentences.en: One based on more than its reputation for selling extremely potent weed.
sentences.zh: 这个品牌所依靠的，远不止其以出售极效大麻而闻名的声誉。

sentences.en: Until recently, the company was largely a West Coast phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，该公司在很大程度上还只是一个西海岸的现象级品牌。

sentences.en: But as marijuana legalization spread east, so did cookies.
sentences.zh: 但随着大麻合法化向东蔓延，Cookies也随之扩张。

sentences.en: A little over a year after recreational sales became legal in New Jersey, the chain opened a new location in a bland outdoor mall in Harrison.
sentences.zh: 在新泽西州娱乐性大麻销售合法化一年多后，该连锁店在哈里森的一个乏味的露天购物中心开设了新分店。

sentences.en: Its aesthetic landing somewhere in the startup meets streetwear zone between Apple and Kith.
sentences.zh: 它的美学风格介于初创公司与潮牌之间，有点像苹果和Kith的结合体。

sentences.en: I walked over to a large circular table laden with dozens of jars, each containing a different strain.
sentences.zh: 我走到一张摆满几十个罐子的大型圆桌前，每个罐子里都装着不同品种的大麻。

sentences.en: There were long-time cookies stalwarts like Gary Payton, a collaboration with the NBA legend, and new variants with names like
sentences.zh: 这里有老牌的Cookies常青树，比如与NBA传奇人物合作的加里·佩顿，以及名字各异的新品种，

sentences.en: Mexican Flan and Dirty Muffler.
sentences.zh: 如墨西哥蛋挞和脏消音器。

sentences.en: There, I met Nikola Pavlovich, a genial salesman wearing a flamingo-patterned bucket hat atop long hair, canvas moccasins, and a shirt covered in psychedelic flowers.
sentences.zh: 在那里，我遇到了尼古拉·巴甫洛维奇，他是一位温和的销售员，一头长发上戴着一顶火烈鸟图案的渔夫帽，穿着帆布莫卡辛鞋，衬衫上印满了迷幻的花朵。

sentences.en: Pavlovich, 31, is an aspiring stand-up comic who began smoking to help with anxiety and found himself down what he called the cannosaur rabbit hole, reading forum posts
sentences.zh: 现年31岁的巴甫洛维奇是一位有抱负的单口喜剧演员，他最初为了缓解焦虑而开始吸烟，结果发现自己陷入了他所说的大麻深渊，开始阅读论坛帖子

sentences.en: about exotic hybrid genetics and terpene levels.
sentences.zh: 关于奇异的杂交基因和萜烯含量。

sentences.en: This expertise eventually took him to cookies, where his role is to match customers with the ideal strain for their lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 这种专业知识最终把他带到了Cookies，他的职责是将顾客与最适合其生活方式的大麻品种进行匹配。

sentences.en: I asked what he would suggest for a freelance reporter who might want to enliven dull afternoons at home in front of the computer.
sentences.zh: 我问他会向一位可能想在电脑前让沉闷的下午在家中变得生动起来的自由撰稿人推荐什么。

sentences.en: Pavlovich recommended a strain called laughing gas.
sentences.zh: 巴甫洛维奇推荐了一种名为“笑气”的品种。

sentences.en: This is like renting a Ferrari in Miami and going on a straight highway, he told me, and just slowly pressing the gas.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，这就像在迈阿密租一辆法拉利开上直路，然后慢慢踩下油门一样。

sentences.en: All around us were neatly labeled
sentences.zh: 我们四周摆放着整齐贴好标签的

sentences.en: $70 jars of weed and $300 bongs laser-etched with the Cookies logo.
sentences.zh: 售价70美元的大麻罐和激光刻有Cookies标志的300美元水烟筒。

sentences.en: And, of course, hoodies.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有连帽衫。

sentences.en: Cookies clothing plays a key role in both the brand's origin story and its current marketing strategy.
sentences.zh: Cookies的服装在品牌的起源故事和当前的营销策略中都起着关键作用。

sentences.en: The brand predates any legal marijuana regime when Cookies was strictly a black market concern hoodies and hat sales allowed it to gain a foothold above ground.
sentences.zh: 该品牌诞生于任何合法大麻制度出现之前，当时Cookies纯粹是一桩黑市生意，连帽衫和帽子的销售让它得以在地下站稳脚跟。

sentences.en: And the soft goods give buyers a way to signal something specific to the outside world.
sentences.zh: 而这些软周边产品为买家提供了一种向外界传递特定信号的方式。

sentences.en: I smoke lots of weed but in the cool Wiz Khalifa way, not the lame suburban mom way.
sentences.zh: 我抽很多大麻，但我是以酷炫的维兹·卡利法的方式，而不是那种讨人厌的郊区妈妈的方式。

sentences.en: People often compare Cookies with the streetwear brand Supreme.
sentences.zh: 人们经常将Cookies与潮牌Supreme进行比较。

sentences.en: That's accurate in one very literal sense.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常字面的意义上，这是准确的。

sentences.en: They each sell a lot of hats and in other more subjective ones.
sentences.zh: 它们都卖很多帽子，而在其他更主观的层面上也是如此。

sentences.en: They share a penchant for collaboration-based marketing.
sentences.zh: 它们都有对基于合作营销的偏好。

sentences.en: Their appeal to mainstream audiences is tied up with their implied connections to illicit subcultures and they've each been expanding rapidly in recent years
sentences.zh: 它们对主流受害的吸引力与它们暗示的非法亚文化联系紧密，而且近年来它们都在迅速扩张

sentences.en: thanks to infusions of venture capital.
sentences.zh: 多亏了风险投资的注入。

sentences.en: Harrison was the 64th Cookies outlet to open in the United States.
sentences.zh: 哈里森是Cookies在美国开业的第64家门店。

sentences.en: There are also retail locations in Israel, Thailand, and Canada.
sentences.zh: 它在以色列、泰国和加拿大也设有零售点。

sentences.en: All of it is inextricable from Burner, the stage name of Gilbert Milam, 40, the company's co-founder and chief executive who spent two decades as a rapper
sentences.zh: 这一切都与40岁的吉尔伯特·米勒姆（吉尔伯特的艺名为伯纳）密不可分，他是该公司的联合创始人兼首席执行官，曾花了两十年时间做说唱歌手

sentences.en: with a sideline as a dealer or as a dealer with a sideline as a rapper.
sentences.zh: 副业是毒贩，或者说是个副业是说唱歌手的毒贩。

sentences.en: The two roles have long propped each other up to the point that Milam is estimated by some to be a centimillionaire, though any estimate of his net worth depends largely on
sentences.zh: 这两种角色长期以来相互支撑，以至于米勒姆被一些人估计身家过亿，尽管对他净资产的任何估计很大程度上取决于

sentences.en: how much you think Cookies is worth.
sentences.zh: 你认为Cookies价值几何。

sentences.en: He claimed in a 2019 podcast interview to have rejected an $800 million offer for the company.
sentences.zh: 他在2019年的一次播客采访中声称，自己曾拒绝了一笔高达8亿美元的收购公司的报价。

sentences.en: A 2022 report from the journalist
sentences.zh: 记者扎克·奥马利·格林伯格在2022年的一份报告中

sentences.en: Zach O'Malley Greenberg placed his worth at $410 million.
sentences.zh: 将其身家定为4.1亿美元。

sentences.en: Forbes, meanwhile, valued Cookies at a more conservative
sentences.zh: 与此同时，《福布斯》杂志在2022年撰文报道米勒姆时，

sentences.en: $150 million when it wrote about Milam in 2022.
sentences.zh: 给Cookies估出了更为保守的1.5亿美元。

sentences.en: Any of these figures would make him one of the wealthiest rappers in the world without him having ever released a hit record or even one that most rap fans have heard of.
sentences.zh: 无论哪个数字，都能让他成为世界上最富有的说唱歌手之一，尽管他从未发行过热门唱片，甚至连大多数说唱迷都没听过他的歌。

sentences.en: Many of these estimates were made early on in the Biden administration when states like New Jersey and Montana were moving to legalize and there was still hope
sentences.zh: 其中许多估计是在拜登政府早期做出的，当时新泽西州和蒙大拿州等州正着手合法化，人们仍然抱有希望

sentences.en: that democratic control of the executive branch might lead to quick decriminalization or rescheduling of the drug at the federal level.
sentences.zh: 行政部门的民主党控制可能会导致联邦层面的迅速非罪化或大麻重新列管。

sentences.en: O'Malley Greenberg recently reassessed
sentences.zh: 奥马利·格林伯格最近重新评估了

sentences.en: Milam's net worth at $250 million.
sentences.zh: 米勒姆的净资产为2.5亿美元。

sentences.en: What happened instead was a national patchwork of chaos.
sentences.zh: 然而实际发生的是全国范围内的一片混乱。

sentences.en: Every state's laws and agricultural profile are different, making it extremely hard for national brands to operate within the rules and easy for bad actors to take advantage.
sentences.zh: 每个州的法律和农业概况都各不相同，这使得全国性品牌极难在规则范围内运营，却让违规者极易从中谋利。

sentences.en: Several cannabis sources I spoke to said that it has long been an open secret that major legal companies are flooding the black market with legally grown cannabis.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的几位大麻业内人士表示，大型合法公司正用合法种植的大麻向黑市倾销，这长期以来一直是公开的秘密。

sentences.en: Look no farther than the vast quantities of weed for sale in New York City at unlicensed stores.
sentences.zh: 看看纽约市无证商店里销售的大量大麻就知道了。

sentences.en: The legal market has been cannibalized by the black market, said Josh Berman, a cannabis veteran who has known Milam for about a decade and previously worked as cookies grower
sentences.zh: 合法市场已经被黑市蚕食了，曾在华盛顿州担任过Cookies种植者和加工商、认识米勒姆大约十年的资深大麻从业者乔希·伯曼说道。

sentences.en: and processor in Washington State.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州的加工商。

sentences.en: The same people who are selling in stores are the same people controlling the black market and they're picking and choosing which lane makes the most sense.
sentences.zh: 在商店里销售的人和控制黑市的人是同一拨人，他们正在权衡并挑选哪种渠道最合算。

sentences.en: Cookies, more than most players in the cannabis business, trades on its origins in the pre-legalization days.
sentences.zh: 与大麻行业的绝大多数参与者相比，Cookies更多地利用了其在大麻合法化之前的起源。

sentences.en: It is an empire Milam built on a series of risky moves, first by entering the cannabis black market and then by turning his participation in it into the cornerstone
sentences.zh: 这是米勒姆通过一系列冒险举动建立的帝国，首先是进入大麻黑市，然后将他参与其中的经历变成了一个高知名度品牌的基石

sentences.en: of a recognizable brand, long before legalization made that safe.
sentences.zh: 早在合法化使其变得安全之前就已经如此。

sentences.en: The core of Milam's appeal is the charismatic narrative of his rise from black market hustler to mogul.
sentences.zh: 米勒姆的魅力核心在于他从黑市贩子逆袭为大亨的富有魅力的传奇故事。

sentences.en: Yet the tension between the street and the nascent legal cannabis industry, the latter still struggling to distance itself from the former, has brought with it some thorny problems
sentences.zh: 然而，街头文化与新兴的合法大麻产业之间的张力——后者仍在艰难地试图与前者划清界限——也给他的公司和整个行业带来了一些棘手的问题

sentences.en: for his company and the industry at large.
sentences.zh: 给他的公司和整个行业。
